title: Actual-LCM positive tail corridor, true-survivor sign, and top-edge obstruction

concepts.label: actual-LCM translated tail difference
concepts.note: The difference between totient tails at the translated heights 2H+J and H+J for H=periodLcm(2^a).

concepts.label: short offset corridor
concepts.note: The range J+K+(a+6)<2*2^a in which the LCM arithmetic letters remain controlled.

concepts.label: true endpoint survivor
concepts.note: The signed carry-orbit value associated with an integral representative of the actual tail difference.

concepts.label: top-edge discrepancy residue
concepts.note: The congruence representative P-e lying strictly inside the final band (P-B,P).

concepts.label: actual-LCM tail orbit
concepts.note: The J=0 translated actual-LCM tail difference.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For a at least eight and J+(a+6)<2*2^a, with H=periodLcm(2^a), the translated difference totientTail(2H+J)-totientTail(H+J) is strictly positive.
statement_nodes.engine: positive arithmetic-letter expansion of the actual-LCM translated tail difference
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Lean proves the sign theorem; no external priority or novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The result is uniform in unbounded a but only in the displayed short-offset corridor. Positivity is not nonintegrality or irrationality.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For every a at least eight, actualLcmTailOrbit a is strictly positive.
statement_nodes.engine: zero-offset specialization of the positive translated-tail corridor
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is the J=0 specialization of the corridor theorem.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Positivity does not show that the orbit is nonintegral and does not supply the Z28 nonintegrality frontier.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: If an integer d represents the translated actual-LCM tail difference and the J+K corridor remains short, then -carryOrbit H (H+J) d K is strictly negative and is an endpoint survivor.
open_antecedents: an integer d whose real cast equals the displayed translated actual-LCM tail difference
statement_nodes.engine: exact carry tracking of a positive translated tail difference
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is a project-specific conditional carry-orbit transport.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem removes only the nonnegative branch of the true survivor; negative true survivors and spurious survivors remain, so no nonintegrality follows.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Under the short-corridor, integral-representative, and room hypotheses, if e=carryOrbit H (H+J) d K, P=2^K, and B=2H+J+K+2, then the discrepancy residue is exactly P-e and lies strictly between P-B and P.
open_antecedents: an integer d representing the translated actual-LCM tail difference
statement_nodes.engine: conversion of the negative true survivor into its least positive top-edge residue
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is a route-boundary theorem internal to the certificate formalisation.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem explains why positivity alone gives no symmetric certified kill. It neither proves integrality nor excludes the top-edge band required by Z36.

intra_zone_relations.basis: actualLcmTailOrbit is the J=0 translated tail difference, and the source theorem applies the corridor result at that offset.
Exact carry tracking transports positivity of the later translated tail difference into positivity of the carry and hence negativity of the true endpoint survivor.
Under the room bound, the negative survivor's congruence class is represented exactly by the top-edge residue P-e.
The top-edge conclusion proves that the positive-sign corridor alone cannot furnish the symmetric central-arc exclusion needed for a modular kill.
